summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct US-listed universe for the nuclear fuel-cycle/components/project-execution node. The strongest direct chokepoint exposure is Centrus Energy for US HALEU/enrichment capacity. BWX Technologies remains the reference nuclear-components and fuel-manufacturing leader. The underfollowed lane adds Mirion Technologies as a nuclear instrumentation/radiation-monitoring supplier and ASP Isotopes as a speculative small-cap HALEU/enrichment-technology shadow candidate. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation. Layer 1B expansion found a compact US-listed universe around the nuclear fuel-and-components chokepoint. The strongest direct bottleneck exposure is Centrus Energy for domestic HALEU enrichment. BWX Technologies is a larger-cap reference-quality supplier with nuclear components, advanced fuel, and TRISO/HALEU handling evidence. Flowserve and Crane are less obvious second-order suppliers where nuclear-qualified pumps, valves, diagnostics, and certification-heavy components may become scarce if nuclear restarts, uprates, SMRs, and advanced reactors accelerate. No buy/sell view is implied; these are research candidates requiring revenue-exposure verification. Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the nuclear fuel/components chokepoint. The strongest direct public-market scarcity signals appear in HALEU enrichment and deconversion, nuclear-qualified components, and EPC/project execution capacity.
